The prologue

The empty tray

At eleven fifty-eight on the last night of November, the lights went out at JollyMix House. When they came back, Madam Bonbon’s showpiece advent calendar was still under its glass dome. All twenty-four foil seals looked untouched. The chocolates were gone.

Four people were in the house: Madam Bonbon, her butler Mr Crumb, the chocolatier Clara Temper, and the groundskeeper Basil Nut. Each insists the others had a key. Nobody admits to having a sweet tooth.

In the first empty well lay a note: “One clue a day. Keep your own counsel until Christmas Eve.” You’ve been asked to investigate, preferably before anyone puts the kettle on.
